verdict.rationale: GitHub documents a cloud coding agent that can be assigned tasks from GitHub, autonomously plan/explore/execute in the background, and produce reviewable, mergeable pull requests from a centralized workspace, plus automations that trigger the agent from repository events (e.g., issues) — this directly maps to turning a tracked issue into an end-to-end PR. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence specifically validating the issue-to-PR workflow's success rate or quality, and explicit documentation of an 'assign issue to Copilot' UI step (only inferred from 'launch work from GitHub' and automations).
